verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
My life is in You, Lord
My strength is in You, Lord

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
My hope is in You, Lord
In You, it's in You

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
I will praise You with all of my life
I will praise You with
All of my strength

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
With all of my life
With all of my strength
All my hope is in You
